items.title: Yemen: Riyadh should positively respond to Al-Azhar’s call to end war
items.summary: Tehran, IRNA – Yemen’s ministry of foreign affairs once again welcomed the call by the Sheikh of Al-Azhar to end the conflict and urged the international community to pressure Saudi Arabia to halt attacks and lift the siege on Yemen.

items.title: Yemeni forces target Saudi defense ministry, oil and airport facilities
items.summary: Tehran, IRNA – The spokesperson for the Yemeni Armed Forces said that over the past 48 hours, four major targets in Saudi Arabia including ministry of defense building in Riyadh, Aramco facility in Yanbu, and King Fahd and Abha airports were attacked with ballistic missiles and drones.

items.title: Iran not seeking war, but fully prepared to defend itself: envoy
items.summary: London, IRNA – Iran’s ambassador to Norway stressed that Tehran is not seeking war, but is fully prepared to defend itself against any new military aggression, and that the initiators of war must pay the price.

items.title: Iran Army chief says drone capabilities strengthened, forces ready for asymmetric warfare
items.summary: Tehran, IRNA – Iranian Army Chief Commander Major General Amir Hatami says the Army has strengthened its drone capabilities and is prepared for asymmetric warfare, citing lessons learned from the two wars imposed by the United States and Israel over the past year.

items.title: Baqaei: Broken US promises, not Iranians’ religious beliefs, obstruct negotiations
items.summary: Tehran, IRNA – Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baqaei has rejected US claims that Iranian religious beliefs are an obstacle to negotiations, saying the impasse stems from Washington’s negotiating approach and failure to honor its commitments.

items.title: IRGC Navy says four oil-carrying ships hit in Persian Gulf
items.summary: Tehran, IRNA – The Islamic Revolution Guards Corps (IRGC) Navy has said four ships were hit and caught fire while transferring oil cargoes in the northern Persian Gulf, adding that three other vessels had suffered incidents after striking mines west of the Strait of Hormuz.

items.title: Iran urges Europe to condemn US-Israeli military aggression
items.summary: Tehran, IRNA – Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi has urged European countries to condemn the military aggression against Iran, stressing that Tehran will firmly defend its national sovereignty and territorial integrity against any threat or attack.

items.title: Iran urges UNSC to condemn US maritime blockade, calls for its immediate removal
items.summary: New York, IRNA – Iran has urged the UN Security Council to condemn as continued US aggression through a maritime blockade, demanding its immediate lifting and warning that the blockade, economic sanctions and threats against Iranian infrastructure violate the UN Charter and international law and pose serious humanitarian risks to civilians.

items.title: Qatar, France call for opening of Hormuz and Gaza ceasefire implementation
items.summary: Qatari and French leaders stress need to restore freedom of navigation in Strait of Hormuz.

items.title: One killed, eight injured in attack on Saudi Arabia’s King Fahd airport
items.summary: Injured immediately transported to hospitals as aviation authority says updates will be forthcoming.

items.title: Iran war live: IRGC vows invasion as defence doctrine turns ‘offensive’
items.summary: Iran's IRGC threatens to invade any country that attacks it under a new 'offensive and asymmetrical' doctrine.

items.title: What happened during Witkoff and Kushner’s latest meeting with Putin
items.summary: The latest round of negotiations comes amid growing concerns in Kyiv the US is backing away from its support of Ukraine.

items.title: Sixth Committee Considers Potential Rules Governing Expulsion of Foreigners, Responsibility of International Organizations
items.summary: The Sixth Committee (Legal) today took stock of two sets of draft articles adopted by the International Law Commission — relating to the responsibility of international organizations and the expulsion of aliens — as delegations debated whether these provisions are suitable for formal codification.
